Marta (sales): Orchid Systems wants a 21-day POC. Needs hosted API keys, a tiny Dedicated pool for bursts to 25 rps, and VPC peering. Also asked for a $2k spend cap and $1k starter credits. Can billing spin up a project?
Ethan (billing): Yes. Send org_id and billing contact. Hard stop on spend cap requires signed addendum. Do they want soft or hard stop?
Marta (sales): They want hard stop. Org id orchid-01, billing contact ops@orchidsys.com.
Keiko (solutions): Recommend locking models to 13B quantized and setting quota to 250k tokens/day, 180 rpm. Routing: prefer dedicated -> hosted-small.
Ravi (infra): For peering we need CIDR and ingress ports. Turnaround ~48 hours after we get CIDR + signed AUP.
Marta (sales): I'll collect CIDR and get the signed addendum today.
DevEx Bot: CLI quick example to create a temp project for devs:
```
redwoodctl project create --org orchid-01 --name="orchid-poc" --spend-cap=2000 --credits=1000 --models="13b-q" --quota-tokens=250000 --quota-rpm=180
```
Ephemeral keys expire 14d.
Ethan (billing): Received payload. I'll provision once addendum is uploaded. Ticket #POC-4210 opened.
Marta (sales): Thanks — will post the signed doc and CIDR here when I have them. :thumbsup:
